title: SG-8.4.2 Loading message while history loads, list stays rendered
summary: Show 'Loading your suggestions…' only while history is really loading; keep the Your suggestions list rendered
description: Context: ContributionSheet already renders 'Loading your suggestions…' while listMine is pending and always renders the 'Your suggestions' list. Gap: historyStatus starts as 'loading' and the history effect returns early when roundId is '' or the sheet is closed, so the message stays visible forever in that state, which the 401-retry test in tests/contribution.test.tsx uses. Desired behavior: the message appears only while a history request is in flight, and the list remains rendered so the 401-retry test still passes unchanged. Why: avoid a permanent misleading loading state.
acceptance_criteria: Given roundId is 'round-1' and listMine is pending, when the sheet opens, then 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown and the 'Your suggestions' list is rendered
Given roundId is '', when the sheet opens, then 'Loading your suggestions…' is not shown and the 'Your suggestions' list is rendered
Given the existing 401-retry test, when it runs, then it passes unchanged

preserve: Existing loading, error and Retry behavior
Merge of history with in-flight entries

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript; keep the HistoryStatus type 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'
No mock data replacing the real listMine call
definition_of_done: Loading message never persists without a request in flight
